propositions: The dc_store_copy_repo fixture calls git fetch/archive/ls-tree with capture_output=True and check=True, which captures stderr but discards it in the CalledProcessError, making failures undiagnosable.
Live run 31587452003 failed at dc_store_copy_repo fixture setup with exit status 128 from git fetch origin tickets, but git's actual error reason was lost.
The fixture performs a single un-retried network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job, so transient failures take the entire cell down as an ERROR.
A new run_git helper must route git calls through a custom error handler that raises RuntimeError containing the joined command, exit status, and git's verbatim stderr.
The fetch_tickets function must retry transient failures a bounded number of times with backoff before raising the diagnostic error, enforcing retry-then-fail policy rather than skip-on-failure.
